title: Brasaland Telemetry Event Registry
description: Registry of allowed telemetry events. Each definition is a complete event envelope with an allowlisted properties object. A property is required exactly when named in that event's properties.required array; other allowlisted properties are optional. x- annotations document implementation metadata; properties.additionalProperties=false is the enforcement boundary.

eventId.description: Unique event UUID; retain across retries.

sessionId.description: Random session identifier, never an auth token; null when no user session exists.

userId.description: Pseudonymous internal user identifier; null for anonymous/system events.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of this event contract.

requestId.description: Correlation UUID shared across client, API and logs; client-generated for events without a request.

country.description: Country code for the location; independent of UI language.

product_id.description: Stable product identifier, not a free-text product name.

quantity.description: Event-specific quantity; see telemetry plan for threshold/rejected-attempt semantics.

currency.description: Local currency; never converted in telemetry capture.

supplier_id.description: Stable supplier identifier; do not send supplier contact details.

inbound_order_created.description: A location records receipt of goods from a supplier.
inbound_order_created.x-hypothesis: We need to know what and how much each location buys from each supplier.
inbound_order_created.x-decision: Consolidate purchases across locations to negotiate better supplier prices.
inbound_order_created.x-sensitivity: Business purchasing data; no employee or customer PII.

unit_price.description: Price per unit in currency; never converted.

outbound_order_created.description: A location records ingredient consumption for food preparation.
outbound_order_created.x-hypothesis: We need to know which ingredients are consumed and at what rate by location.
outbound_order_created.x-sensitivity: Operational inventory data; no employee or customer PII.

reason.description: The outbound movement represents ingredient consumption in meal preparation.

stock_waste_registered.description: A location records inventory loss, spoilage, kitchen error or suspected theft.
stock_waste_registered.x-hypothesis: We need to know how much product is lost, why and at which location.
stock_waste_registered.x-decision: Prioritize waste audits at locations with the weakest indicator.
stock_waste_registered.x-sensitivity: Operational inventory data; theft reason is a controlled enum, not an accusation about a person.

reason.description: Required merma cause from the company context.

outbound_order_id.description: Stable OutboundOrder identifier that records this waste movement.

stock_threshold_triggered.description: Stock crosses below the minimum configured for a product at a location.
stock_threshold_triggered.x-hypothesis: We need to know how often a location falls short of a key ingredient.
stock_threshold_triggered.x-decision: Adjust the minimum threshold or replenishment frequency.
stock_threshold_triggered.x-sensitivity: Operational inventory data; no personal data.

quantity.description: Stock balance after the committed movement that crossed below minimum.

minimum_quantity.description: Configured location-specific minimum in the same unit.

threshold_version.description: Version of threshold configuration used for this crossing.

direct_stock_edit_rejected.description: An attempt to change stock outside a traceable inbound or outbound order is rejected.
direct_stock_edit_rejected.x-hypothesis: We need to know whether staff attempt to bypass stock traceability.
direct_stock_edit_rejected.x-decision: Reinforce training or permissions at locations with recurring attempts.
direct_stock_edit_rejected.x-sensitivity: Actor is pseudonymous in userId; do not include names, raw request body or free-text reason.

quantity.description: Attempted quantity, including zero or negative values rejected by the stock-mutation rule.

ingredient_price_variance_detected.description: Received ingredient unit price exceeds the configured variance against history for the same product and supplier.
ingredient_price_variance_detected.x-hypothesis: We need to know when a key ingredient has an anomalous price increase.
ingredient_price_variance_detected.x-decision: Alert purchasing to renegotiate or seek an alternative supplier.
ingredient_price_variance_detected.x-sensitivity: Commercially sensitive price data; access restricted to purchasing/finance; currency remains local.

current_unit_price.description: Received price per product unit in the location currency.

historical_unit_price.description: Comparison price for same product/supplier/currency and configured period.

threshold_percent.description: Configured percentage that triggered this event.

inventory_order_validation_failed.description: An inbound/outbound inventory order fails one or more controlled validation rules.
inventory_order_validation_failed.x-hypothesis: We need to know which rules and products produce order errors.
inventory_order_validation_failed.x-decision: Prioritize fixes to forms, catalog data or training.
inventory_order_validation_failed.x-sensitivity: No raw form values or request body; only controlled rule codes.

order_type.description: Kind of inventory operation that failed validation.

failure_codes.description: Controlled validation rules failed by this submission; never raw validation text.

item_count.description: Number of submitted order lines, not their values.

failed_product_ids.description: Stable IDs for product lines that failed; omit when the error is order-level.

purchase_order_created.description: A purchase request is submitted to a supplier; it is not a receipt and does not itself change stock.
purchase_order_created.x-hypothesis: We need to know purchase-request volume by location and supplier.
purchase_order_created.x-decision: Review purchasing workload and connect requests to later receipts.
purchase_order_created.x-sensitivity: Commercial data; IDs only, no supplier contact or free-text notes.

purchase_order_id.description: Stable purchase request identifier; distinct from an inbound receipt.

line_count.description: Number of product lines in the request; no item body is copied.

workflow_started.x-hypothesis: We need a denominator of started workflows to measure completion and abandonment rates.
workflow_started.x-decision: Identify flows with high drop-off and prioritize usability work.
workflow_started.x-sensitivity: Behavioral event; random workflow instance ID only, no field contents.

workflow_instance_id.description: Random UUID to correlate this workflow instance without using business or personal IDs.

entry_source.description: Controlled source that opened the workflow.

workflow_completed.description: A supported user workflow completes successfully.
workflow_completed.x-hypothesis: We need to know which started workflows complete and how long completion takes.
workflow_completed.x-decision: Compare completion rates and simplify slow or confusing flows.
workflow_completed.x-sensitivity: Behavioral event; random workflow instance ID only, no form values.

workflow_instance_id.description: Random UUID matching the corresponding start event.

elapsed_seconds.description: Elapsed time from workflow_started, rounded to whole seconds.

workflow_abandoned.description: A supported workflow was started but not completed within the inactivity window or before route exit.
workflow_abandoned.x-hypothesis: We need to know which workflows and steps users abandon.
workflow_abandoned.x-decision: Simplify the flow or investigate blocking dependencies.
workflow_abandoned.x-sensitivity: Behavioral data; pseudonymous actor only, no field contents; abandonment is not an employee-performance measure.

workflow_instance_id.description: Random UUID matching the corresponding start event.

last_completed_step.description: Last completed controlled step; never user-entered text.

elapsed_seconds.description: Elapsed time from workflow_started, rounded to whole seconds.

completion_state.description: Controlled reason the workflow is considered abandoned.

auth_login_succeeded.x-hypothesis: We need to understand valid access volume and authentication method.
auth_login_succeeded.x-decision: Plan support and detect unusual shifts in access patterns.
auth_login_succeeded.x-sensitivity: userId is pseudonymous; never include username, email, password, token or IP.

auth_method.description: Controlled authentication method used for the successful login.

role.description: Role assigned to the authenticated account.

client_area.description: Controlled application area initiating the login.

auth_login_failed.x-hypothesis: We need to know daily failed-login frequency and controlled failure causes without collecting credentials.
auth_login_failed.x-decision: Detect abuse, account issues or access problems and tune protections.
auth_login_failed.x-sensitivity: No username/email, password, IP, request body or userId; sessionId/userId may be null.

failure_reason.description: Controlled failure class; unknown account and wrong password map to invalid_credentials.

client_area.description: Controlled application area initiating the login.

session_expired.description: An authenticated session/token is observed to expire or be revoked.
session_expired.x-hypothesis: We need to know how often token expiry interrupts workflows.
session_expired.x-decision: Tune token lifetime or improve reauthentication UX.
session_expired.x-sensitivity: Pseudonymous user/session IDs only; never emit the JWT or token claims beyond approved role.

session_age_seconds.description: Approximate elapsed session age when expiry was observed.

client_area.description: Controlled application area where expiry was observed.

access_denied.description: An authenticated actor is denied access by authorization policy.
access_denied.x-hypothesis: We need to know which protected actions are denied and by which controlled rule.
access_denied.x-decision: Correct permission configuration or review suspicious patterns.
access_denied.x-sensitivity: userId is pseudonymous; resource is a route template, never a raw URL or supplied identifier.

resource_type.description: Controlled resource category, not a resource ID or URL.

http_status.description: HTTP status returned to the caller.

actor_role.description: Role category at the time of denial.

user_account_created.x-hypothesis: We need to know account creation volume and role assignment.
user_account_created.x-decision: Plan onboarding and audit role assignment.
user_account_created.x-sensitivity: No email/name; userId is pseudonymous and role is an approved enum.

assigned_role.description: Role assigned to the newly created account.

creation_source.description: Controlled source of the account creation.

user_account_updated.description: Account credentials metadata or role is updated.
user_account_updated.x-hypothesis: We need to know the frequency and category of account/role changes.
user_account_updated.x-decision: Review access governance and administrative errors.
user_account_updated.x-sensitivity: No email, name, phone, address or old/new credential values; userId is pseudonymous.

changed_fields.description: Names of changed fields only; values such as email are never emitted.

change_source.description: Controlled source of the account update.

user_account_deleted.x-hypothesis: We need to know account deactivation volume and confirm access cleanup.
user_account_deleted.x-decision: Check that account offboarding is timely.
user_account_deleted.x-sensitivity: No email/name; actor and target identifiers are pseudonymous; do not retain a deleted identity mapping in analytics.

actor_role.description: Role category of the actor who requested deletion.

section_viewed.description: A user enters a normalized application section.
section_viewed.x-hypothesis: We need to know which backoffice sections operators visit most.
section_viewed.x-sensitivity: Behavioral data linked only to pseudonymous user/session; no raw URL or query parameters.

section_id.description: Normalized section identifier, not a raw URL.

api_latency_recorded.description: A completed API request duration is recorded using a monotonic clock.
api_latency_recorded.x-hypothesis: We need to know response-time distributions by route and status.
api_latency_recorded.x-decision: Prioritize API optimization and capacity using percentiles.
api_latency_recorded.x-sensitivity: No query string, body, IP, user-agent or raw URL; successful requests may be sampled.

route_template.description: Normalized route pattern, e.g. /users/{user_id}; no concrete path values.

http_method.description: HTTP method for the API request.

duration_ms.description: Request duration in milliseconds measured with a monotonic clock.

sample_rate.description: Fraction of eligible requests sampled, from greater than 0 through 1.

api_request_failed.description: An API request returns a failure response.
api_request_failed.x-hypothesis: We need to know which normalized API routes fail and with what stable status/error class.
api_request_failed.x-decision: Prioritize regressions and identify service incidents.
api_request_failed.x-delivery: stream for 5xx under 10 seconds; batch expected 4xx counts
api_request_failed.x-sensitivity: No body, raw error message, query, IP or concrete URL; failure code is controlled.

route_template.description: Normalized route pattern; no concrete path values, query string or URL.

http_method.description: HTTP method for the failed API request.

status_code.description: Failure status code returned to the caller.

error_code.description: Controlled failure class; never a raw exception or response message.

retryable.description: Whether retrying this request is expected to be safe and potentially successful.

frontend_error_captured.description: An uncaught or boundary-captured client error is reported by fingerprint.
frontend_error_captured.x-hypothesis: We need to know how often uncaught client errors affect each interface area.
frontend_error_captured.x-decision: Prioritize fixes that block operator work.
frontend_error_captured.x-sensitivity: Only a generated fingerprint and controlled area/severity; no raw message, stack, form values or URL.

error_fingerprint.description: Stable one-way fingerprint generated from a sanitized error class; not a raw message or stack.

component_area.description: Controlled interface area where the error was captured.

release.description: Short deployment release identifier without build secrets or environment values.

occurrence_count_bucket.description: Number of occurrences in the throttle window, represented as a bucket.

incident_analysis_completed.description: CSV incident analysis finishes successfully; file contents are not retained in telemetry.
incident_analysis_completed.x-hypothesis: We need to know analysis volume, duration and summarized data-quality outcomes.
incident_analysis_completed.x-decision: Size the workflow and prioritize data-quality improvements.
incident_analysis_completed.x-sensitivity: Never include filename, CSV rows, incident descriptions, customer IDs, reporter IDs or raw file content.

total_records.description: Number of CSV records analyzed; no row contents are included.

invalid_records.description: Number of invalid or incomplete records.

file_size_bytes.description: Uploaded file size, without retaining its filename or contents.

incident_analysis_failed.description: CSV incident analysis fails at a controlled processing stage.
incident_analysis_failed.x-hypothesis: We need to know which analysis stage fails and how often by stable error class.
incident_analysis_failed.x-decision: Fix data validation, file limits or service availability.
incident_analysis_failed.x-delivery: stream for internal errors under 30 seconds; batch invalid-file counts
incident_analysis_failed.x-sensitivity: Never include filename, CSV rows, descriptions, IDs from the file, raw exception or stack trace.

failure_stage.description: Controlled stage at which processing stopped.

error_code.description: Controlled failure code; no raw exception or file value.

file_size_bytes.description: Uploaded file size, without filename or contents.

duration_ms.description: Elapsed processing time before failure in milliseconds.

background_job_failed.description: A scheduled or asynchronous internal job fails.
background_job_failed.x-hypothesis: We need to know which internal executions fail and whether retries recover.
background_job_failed.x-decision: Retry, pause dependent work or alert the operational owner.
background_job_failed.x-sensitivity: No job input/output payload, stack trace, secret, endpoint credential or personal data.

job_name.description: Controlled name of the scheduled or asynchronous job.

failure_code.description: Controlled failure classification, without exception text.

will_retry.description: Whether the scheduler plans another attempt.

duration_ms.description: Elapsed execution time before failure in milliseconds.
